merged.note: Competent and honest, but plainer; generic detail, flat voice, quiet ending without much surprise.

writing-skill.note: Clear, credible, useful specifics and a decision framework; a bit tidy and report-like, less distinctive voice.

baseline.note: Warm, vivid, strong kelpie-man ending; slightly literary and polished, but emotionally resonant and very publishable.

storyscope.note: Distinctive funny voice, concrete details (Gary the blister, Gaytime), real stakes with Friday deferral deadline; ends sharply.
